result.Method of Attack: Encrypts files on compromised machines and demands ransom in Monero cryptocurrency for file decryption; distributed as a fake Tor browser installer named 'torbrowser-install-win64-12.0.4_ALL.exe'; appends '.vector_' extension to encrypted files (recent variants) or '.tor' extension (older variant); drops interactive ransom note demanding $250 or $160 worth of Monero; uses Pastebin and ngrok for Command-and-Control communication; may use Remote Access Trojan (XWorm) with ransomware capabilities
result.Attack Vector: Fake Tor browser installer executable; phishing and social engineering implied; Command-and-Control via ngrok tunneling abused by threat actor
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note languages: English, Russian, Norwegian
Pastebin page for ngrok address used for C2
